name: Flame

facts.text: Level 64, 7,000 health, a ghostly fire in the Cursed Forest that casts Flame Strike (300 heat).
A second Flame rises when Luriquay dies.

story:
Fire burns on nothing in the Cursed Forest, and the oldest of those fires has a mind. Flame is what is left of a hearth that burned at the heart of the court wood the night the bargain broke. Nobody fed it, and it did not go out. It drifts between the trees as a ghost-fire now, and it strikes at anything warm enough to be worth burning. The Sylvan say it is lonely. It has found company in Luriquay, whose fire it shares.

At the heart of the court wood there was a hearth, the Sylvan say, where the bright folk and the dark folk sat on opposite sides of one fire and bargained across it. On the night the bargain broke, nobody put the fire out. Nobody fed it either. It did not go out.

Flame is that hearth-fire, wandering. It drifts between the trees as a ghost-fire, burning on bare earth, feeding on nothing, and it strikes at anything warm enough to be worth burning. It is small, as such things go, and its strikes are sharp. It has found company in Luriquay, the lurikeen who drank from the court wood's fires; when Luriquay falls, a second flame rises from him, and the Sylvan think that one is a spark of this one, carried in him all these years. Two fires, one hearth.

The druids say that if both fires are ever put out on the same night, the court wood may start, very slowly, to heal. Nobody has yet managed it on purpose.
legend: A small fight with a sharp bite: its strikes are heat, so heat resists help. It is weak to anything that puts out fire. Watch out when you kill Luriquay nearby, because another Flame rises from him, and two fires at once is how small groups die. Heat resists and quick damage. Superstition: never cook over a fire in the Cursed Forest. It might be this one. Nicknames: 'the hearth', 'the little fire'. Bands who do Flame and Luriquay on the same night say the forest feels lighter afterward. Superstition: never lay a torch on bare ground near the forest's heart, or Flame takes it as an invitation.

loremasterTopic.text: The ghost of a hearth-fire from the night the court wood broke. It burns on nothing and strikes at anything warm.

bookPage: From Derbáil of Ardee's list: grandmother said there was a hearth at the heart of the court wood, with the bright folk on one side and the dark folk on the other, and that on the night the bargain broke nobody put the fire out. It has been burning on nothing ever since and walking about. Never cook over a fire in the Cursed Forest, she said, because you do not know whose fire it is. I have never cooked in any forest since. My husband thinks this is foolish. My husband has never seen a fire walk.
